verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 100.3 (+1.8% in a day) and momentum is 48: prices are steady. 84s cost 700, 85s 1,900 and 86s 4,000. Rivals rewards just paid out, so fodder supply is high this morning.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-15T12:11:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Buy Selma Bacha 86 after its 32% fall, sell in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 12,250 coins. Now 12,000. Buy the dip: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often recovers part of the fall within two days. Picked because it is down 31.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 0 of 2 so far, averaging -15.9% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Buy Mapi León 88 for the weekend, sell by Friday evening
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 11,000 coins. Now 10,000. Buy before the weekend: meta cards are bought for Champions weekend, so they often rise from midweek to Friday evening. Picked because it is meta rating 91 at CB for 11,000 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This is the strategy's first tracked call. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Rivals rewards just paid out: buy SBC fodder now, not later
moves.detail: Rewards add fodder to the market on Thursday morning, which usually makes it cheapest then. Buy what your SBCs need now; selling it again costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 1,900 (0.90 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,000 (0.98 coins per Item Score point), 87s 5,700 (1.04 coins per Item Score point), 88s 9,900 (1.19 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Sydney Schertenleib and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Sydney Schertenleib 76 Rare -87.2%; Grace Geyoro 84 Rare -69.0%; Bryan Mbeumo 84 Rare -66.7%; Eli Junior Kroupi 80 Rare -65.5%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Weslley Pinto Batista SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 11.1K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
